reply.description: The answer to what they asked, in plain prose. Always present. If the document was not changed, this is where the reason goes.

revised.description: true only when `markdown` below is a full rewritten document. false or null when this was a question rather than an instruction.

markdown.description: The COMPLETE revised document in the same markdown shape as the one supplied, or null when nothing was changed. Never a fragment, never a diff — it replaces the file.

changes_made.description: One line per edit actually made, so they can check the change was the one they asked for.

declined.description: Anything asked for that was not done, and why. An instruction that would require inventing a fact belongs here, not in changes_made.
